title: A Melted Chernobyl Reactor Could Kill You in Minutes

scenes.text: At Chernobyl, a lump of melted reactor could kill you in minutes.
After the 1986 explosion, nuclear fuel melted through the floor and mixed with concrete and sand.
It formed a mass of about eleven tons and three metres wide, nicknamed the Elephant's Foot.
At first it gave off more than ten thousand roentgens an hour.
That was enough to deliver a lethal dose in just a few minutes.
A melted reactor that could kill you in minutes.
